headline: Best Buy posts strongest comps in about three years on computing, Switch 2 and phones; raises full-year outlook.
guidance_note: FY26 comps raised to +0.5% to +1.2% (from -1% to +1%); adj EPS $6.25-6.35 (from $6.15-6.30); Q4 comp -1% to +1%.
key_messages: Domestic comp +2.4%, enterprise +2.7%; adj EPS $1.40 beat ~$1.30 consensus.
Computing posted a 7th straight positive quarter; Nintendo Switch 2 drove gaming; mobile phones also grew.
Home theater and appliances declined, showing weakness outside upgrade-cycle categories.
Domestic gross rate fell to 23.3% from 23.6% on lower product margins amid tariff-related costs.
GAAP EPS of $0.66 hit by Best Buy Health impairment.

consumer.big_ticket: Upgrade-driven categories (PCs, gaming, phones) strong; home theater and appliances down.
consumer.pricing: Tariffs weighed on electronics; Best Buy absorbed some costs and diversified sourcing, with shoppers often buying on discount.

macro_read: Consumers will spend on new devices and replacement cycles, but housing-linked durables stay weak and buyers wait for deals.
